candidates.name: Other HM Land Registry plan-related services and guides
verified_facts: The guide describes index-map searches, illustrative plans and Electronic Extent Data as separate plan-related services.
These services support land-registration workflows and mapping information access.
semantic_limits: Plan-related service output or polygon access is not by itself a surveyed vertical measurement or parcel-height accuracy certificate.

candidates.name: How to read a title register
verified_facts: The register records ownership, tenure and legal matters affecting property and is normally read with the title plan.
A dated register copy represents the register state at its stated time.
semantic_limits: Register entries and their legal timestamp do not provide terrain elevation, vertical datum or raster sampling evidence.
